matrix: Subscriptions: a cancel request only goes to staff
description: 'I want to cancel' prepares one request for staff (the server resolves the customer's plan), and the reply says staff decide and nothing has changed.

turns.say: I want to cancel my plan next month

ComposeOut.reply: I've passed your request to cancel Plan Sederhana to our staff, who will decide. Nothing has changed yet.

compose_sees: Your request to cancel Plan Sederhana was passed to our staff to decide. Nothing has changed yet.
